PAWty questions, answered

What is The Fashion PAWty?

It’s a doggie fashion show and community celebration — "A Navigation Celebration" — hosted by the Eye Spy Foundation. Dogs strut the orange carpet while the community enjoys mocktails, food, games, and music, all to support the blind and low vision community and Leader Dogs for the Blind .

When and where is it?

Saturday, September 26, 2026, from 4 to 7 PM at Happy Brew , 3200 Hendricks Ave, Jacksonville, FL 32207.

How much are tickets and what's included?

Tickets are $30 and include general admission, a take-home tote, food, unlimited mocktails, and live music. Get Your PAWty Pass

Who does the event benefit?

The Eye Spy Foundation and Leader Dogs for the Blind . Eye Spy is also sponsoring one Leader Dogs puppy this year.

Can I bring my dog?

To ensure a safe and enjoyable event for everyone, only dogs participating in the fashion show may attend. We love all pups, but space and safety considerations require us to limit attendance to registered runway participants.

Is the event accessible?

Yes — the entire venue is accessible, and accessibility is at the heart of everything we do. Questions about your visit? Email team@eyespy.org and we'll help.

I can't make it — can I still help?

Absolutely. Scroll down to the "Can't make it?" section below for three easy ways to support the cause from anywhere.
